name: Pane
summary: A working side pane beside the page: a heading, a close action, its sections and one status line at its foot. The layout places it (LibraryLayout's aside); it is never a modal and never takes focus on its own. Not for a dialog that needs an answer before going on (a Dialog compound, later) or for page content (use Section).
a11y: A plain region placed by the layout; its heading is level 2 and the close button names what it closes. The status foot is `role="status"`, so changes are announced politely, once.

props.name: title
props.description: What the pane is for, as its heading, e.g. "Revision".

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close action's accessible name and tooltip, naming what it closes, e.g. "Close revision pane".

props.name: children
props.description: The pane's sections, top to bottom.

props.name: status
props.description: One quiet status line at the foot: where things are saved, or a failure with its way out. Announced politely.

props.name: id
props.description: Lets the control that opens the pane name it (`aria-controls`).
